contradictions.finding: Source checkout and page use dated Thursday/Friday slugs while the entitlement catalog uses mcs-full; public copy says one program-wide enrollment across cohorts.
contradictions.safe_hold: Treat dated slugs as candidate context-bearing variants only. Propose no collapse or new offer until Stripe, Plutio, schedule, and owner meaning align; this is not applied policy.

contradictions.finding: The supported calendar feed transiently failed for all six programs, then recovered and returned current schedules for all six. Exact production pool-key/occupancy readback was not authorized or refreshed.
